line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

verification.scope: Ran both original-string-boundaries x86 fixtures. Live GDI extent comparison for six lengths times three prefix modes; instrumented allocation/free, guard bytes, failure and GDI result contract. Not guest painting or full runtime acceptance.

decision: Original PSMGetTextExtent supplies a fixed 255-WCHAR array; GetPrefixCount appends a null after copying ordinary characters. At 255 it needs 256 slots. For longer prefixed captions the measurement also needs the full transformed string. Retain stack use below the threshold, cch+1 allocation and matching release above it, and original GDI return behavior. Actual btnctl paths pass caption length and mngrayc passes caller length. No fixed maximum established by those calls.
